item.title: Entering Fall - and other Seasons
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: If it’s Tuesday, it’s Fall! With the conditions of the world (and, at least for me, money being a bit tight), I’m feeling some stress. With new seasons, we’re always trying to make our way through (this seems even more true this year). Maybe you can identify with some of the ways I’m trying to make it through this season: Here are some of my more recent seasons: Not fun seasons.
